correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact n-phage retarded equations, positive compatible-history restriction, alpha_c=sum(k_i d_i/m_i), q_i*=d_i/m_i and z_i=exp(-mu tau_i). The characteristic equation is triangular with roots 0,-mu,-m_i at equality. Its constant center eigenvector has infected coefficient J=sum k_i q_i*(1-z_i)/mu and phage coefficients sigma_i=q_i*/m_i[k_i(b_i z_i-1)-ell_i J]. In the susceptible coordinate, the exact S equation gives S'=-(sum k_i sigma_i)S^2+O(S^3), so for kappa>0 the one-dimensional attracting center and stable foliation yield tS->1/kappa, tI->J/kappa, t(Q_i-q_i*)->sigma_i/kappa; for kappa<0 positive center drift repels. Parameter-dependent center reduction gives S*=delta/kappa+O(delta^2), with the physically positive side determined by delta/kappa. Verified n=1 example k=ell=d=m=mu=1, tau=log 2: J=1/2 and kappa=(b-3)/2, yielding +1/2 at b=4 and -1/2 at b=2. Positivity and compatibility are essential; finite symbolics alone do not establish stable-foliation asymptotics.
